resources.string: AURA AI uses this accessibility service to read on-screen content so it can help you summarize, translate, explain, and extract information from whatever is currently displayed. No data is sent externally — all processing happens on your device.
Scrollable news headlines with weather and a live clock. Tap a headline to read it.
One-tap shortcuts to ask AURA, talk, scan, or generate an image.
Cards due for review, your streak, and a countdown to the next exam.
